data.title: A document is behind its work when a linked task closes a day or more after the revision shown
data.why: The literal rule (any close after the last revision) flagged 2 of the 3 task-linked documents in this journal, and both had been revised under a minute before their task closed: writing the document and then closing the task is how a task that ships one ends. A day between the revision and the close is the work moving on. Order is still ULID order (I2); the gap is read from the two ULIDs' times and is only a threshold.
data.rejected: Any close after the revision: 2 of 2 false alarms on the first real journal; Ignore bookkeeping events (criteria checks, moves) between revision and close: a document written on day one and closed after a week of code with only moves between would never be flagged
